title: Deep Reinforcement Learning Algorithm Suite
summary: A from-scratch implementation and multi-seed benchmark of model-free, model-based, and offline RL methods.
bullets: Implemented from scratch and benchmarked a broad span of RL methods: REINFORCE with and without baseline, N-step A2C, DQN and Double DQN, PPO, TD3, and SAC — covering clipped policy objectives, GAE, twin critics, entropy regularization, delayed actor updates, and target-network stabilization.

Extended into model-based and offline settings with PETS (probabilistic ensemble dynamics, MPC, CEM trajectory optimization) and offline TD3 with behavior regularization and Conservative Q-Learning, analyzing out-of-distribution value overestimation.

Built transformer-based action-diffusion policies and applied CMA-ES for black-box control, comparing search-based policy learning against gradient-based RL; ran multi-seed evaluation pipelines quantifying variance and return progression across trials.
